has voice

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasVoice
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasVoice
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

Relates a musical work, expression, or segment to one of its voices. Non-functional: a work may have many voices, and a voice may participate in many works.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Entity -> gmeow:Voice

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasVoice from gmeow:Entity to gmeow:Voice when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Entity, gmeow:Voice
